propositions: Schema fields in _config_schema.py may ship with zero read sites, causing config knobs to silently do nothing
An AST-level deterministic check must require at least one attribute-read site (in Load context) for each schema field outside config/schema plumbing
The check matches terminal attribute names (final .field segment) receiver-agnostically to detect all real read patterns (load_config().section.field, self.config.section.field, aliased references)
Fields with zero detected reads must fail CI unless annotated with a '# read-via: <pointer-or-reason>' comment on the field
read-via markers without a pointer or reason are rejected; bare markers fail validation
Indirect/dynamic reads (getattr, client-project-only knobs) are invisible to AST and require the read-via escape hatch with justification
